Question Choices: This is the standard tic-tac-toe board. How many pairs of parallel lines are drawn to make the board?
Hints: Count pairs within each parallel direction; count each horizontal-vertical pair for right-angle intersections.
Solution: The two vertical lines form one parallel pair; the two horizontal lines form another. Total 1+1=2 pairs.

Hints: Intersecting lines cross. Perpendicular lines are the special case meeting at 90 degrees.
Solution: The lines cross, so they intersect. Their meeting angle is not 90 degrees, so they are not perpendicular. Parallel lines do not cross.

Hints: Parallel lines lie in a plane and keep the same distance apart; they never meet.
Solution: Every pair of triangle sides shares a vertex, so their extended supporting lines intersect. No pair can be parallel.

Question Choices: Fill: The steps of the ladder are ________ to each other. (Parallel or Perpendicular)
Hints: Parallel lines lie in a plane and keep the same distance apart; they never meet.
Solution: The depicted ladder rungs run in the same horizontal direction at different heights. Their supporting lines never meet, so the rungs are parallel.

Question Choices: How many pairs of parallel lines are formed by the edges of a stop sign?
Hints: Count pairs within each parallel direction; count each horizontal-vertical pair for right-angle intersections.
Solution: The regular octagonal stop-sign outline has eight sides. Each side pairs with its opposite parallel side; count each pair once:8/2=4 pairs.

Question Choices: Select. Draw an upright capital T using one horizontal top bar and one vertical post meeting its midpoint. What is the relationship between these two segments? ~~Parallel | Perpendicular~~
Hints: A horizontal segment and a vertical segment that meet form right angles.
Solution: The post meets the top bar at 90 degrees on each side. Segments that meet at a right angle are perpendicular. Parallel segments do not meet.

Question Choices: Select. Question Choices: Select. A street runs North-South. Another street runs East-West. What kind of intersection do they form?: ~~Parallel | Perpendicular~~
Hints: Intersecting lines cross. Perpendicular lines are the special case meeting at 90 degrees.
Solution: North-south and east-west directions form a right angle,90 degrees. The crossing streets are perpendicular.

Question Choices: Select. Line segment XY is parallel to segment WZ. If you draw a line connecting X to W that is perpendicular to WZ, will it also be perpendicular to XY? ~~Yes | No~~
Hints: A line perpendicular to one of two parallel lines is perpendicular to the other.
Solution: XY and WZ are parallel. A line perpendicular to WZ makes a 90-degree corresponding angle with XY too, so it is perpendicular to both.
